result.summary: Found 1 issue: a delivery fee in the 'Fastest near you' carousel renders as 'NaN' instead of a price.

issues.description: Under 'Smash Bros Burgers', the delivery fee reads '€NaN delivery' instead of a numeric amount, indicating a missing or failed price calculation being shown directly to the user.
issues.suggestion: Validate the delivery fee before rendering and only display it when it is a valid number; otherwise hide the fee or show a sensible fallback so 'NaN' never appears.
